policy.rule: a period viewed by any prior campaign is RESEARCH_EXPOSED for hypothesis selection, however convenient its boundaries look; it cannot be relabelled 'unseen OOS' from a split alone
policy.sealed_definition: history collected before the spec freeze cannot be sealed: the frozen use it or not, it was seen. The only genuinely sealed sample available to this campaign is forward data accrued after the freeze timestamp

campaign_windows_observed.class: RESEARCH_EXPOSED (panel); the reserved slice is uncounted because its boundaries are recorded in untracked reports

windows.holdout: never read; capture blocked until 30 days accrue

datasets.used_by: ALPHA-001, ALPHA-003, RFC-046 (price leg of all admitted hypotheses)

datasets.content: 5m/15m/1h price for the 4-symbol universe; full funding history; 30-day OI and long-short series
datasets.used_by: ALPHA-002/003 context; funding series relevant to closed carry and funding lines

Farside BTC ETF daily flows + BTC 1d klines
futures contract spec, funding history, 5m klines, depth snapshot
stablecoin supply, hashrate/miner revenue, FRED macro series
datasets.used_by: retrieved and coverage-audited during Phase A for feasibility; therefore not sealable; the decisive test for H-049-001/002 is sealed forward data

vendor_series_classes.blockchain_info_hashrate_8y.json: value dated day t treated as available 00:00 UTC of day t+1

declared_partition_policy.validation: per spec (historical, exposed, declared, degraded status)
declared_partition_policy.sealed_oos: forward-only observations after the freeze timestamp; single opening; recorded with verifier identity and hashes per RFC-049 §10

conclusion: no historical window in this repository qualifies as unseen for daily crypto data; the campaign's confirmatory evidence must come from sealed forward accrual, and any claim built on historical windows is labelled research-exposed

activation_gate.consequence: WP-049-06..10 (implementation, economic experiments, robustness, independent reproduction, final decision) are NOT executed; the campaign state ends at RFC049_PREPARED_AWAITING_CAMPAIGN_AUTHORIZATION
